create_uvdoc_model: create a UVDocModel instance from a UVDocConfig to predict 2D Bezier mesh coordinates for document rectification
build_uvdoc_backbone: build a UVDocBackbone with UVDocBackboneConfig for feature extraction from document images
run_uvdoc_image_processor: run UVDocImageProcessor to preprocess document images with resizing, rescaling, and RGB-to-BGR conversion
test_uvdoc_image_post_process: test UVDocImageProcessor.post_process_document_rectification to convert predicted mesh into rectified document images
summarize_uvdoc_resnet_stage: summarize UVDocResNetStage which contains multiple UVDocResidualBlock layers with dilation and downsampling support
